Lena (CS): Quick heads-up — AuroraAI crossed 73% of monthly credits after ramping up trial users. QBR in 11 days. Theyre nervous about billing surprises; want a simple mitigation plan and a crisp cost narrative for renewal.
Arman (AE): Any idea which flows are the biggest contributors?
Lena (CS): Mix: interactive chat sessions with long contexts and a nightly backfill that re-runs recommendations for new cohorts. Backfill is the main spike.
Peyton (Solutions Eng): Short-term wins: 1) switch backfill to batched async jobs with checkpointing; 2) cap in-chat context for non-critical sessions; 3) enable prefix caching for repeated prompts.
SpendAlertBot: alert: account_usage.auroraai > 70% monthly_credits (triggered at 3167774010).
June (Finance): If they reach 90% before renewal it changes the discount band. I need a 3-scenario spend table (no changes / mitigations / mitigations + commit).
Arman (AE): Customer wants zero-friction fixes first. No hard limits without SRE alignment. Can we offer an opt-in "backfill window" that runs off-peak?
Peyton (Solutions Eng): Yes. Proposal: schedule backfills 02:00-05:00 local, use batch_size=1024, add dedupe pass, and provide an opt-in soft-cap for the last 5 days of the cycle. Snippet for Console rule: 
```yaml
name: aurora-backfill-optin
scope: org:auroraai
action: schedule_backfill_window
window: 02:00-05:00
batch_size: 1024
opt_in: true
```
Lena (CS): I'll schedule a runbook with their infra team tomorrow 9am PT to walk batch/cap plan and collect blocker notes.
Peyton (Solutions Eng): Early estimate: batching + dedupe could cut backfill embeddings/generation tokens by ~35% on our sample. Use that for projections, but flag variance.
June (Finance): Use conservative 25% reduction for the 'mitigations' column and 38% for 'mitigations + quantized/embed-sub' in the spend table. I'll slot numbers into the one-pager.
Arman (AE): I'll draft the 1-page QBR insert: root cause, actions taken, projected spend table, recommended commit/credit ask.
Peyton (Solutions Eng): Also propose an SDK toggle we can ship quickly: "realtime_summary=false" which switches heavy summarizers to light mode by default. I can PR a sample.
Lena (CS): Customer also requested per-route spend labels in Console to aid triage. Filing with ProductOps.
ProdReqBot: feature_request logged: per-route spend labels (id: FR-8795) from AuroraAI.
Arman (AE): Action items: Arman - 1-pager; Lena - runbook + feedback capture; Peyton - PR for batching + SDK toggle; June - spend scenarios and credit modeling.
Lena (CS): I'll collect verbatim feedback during the runbook and paste notes here.
June (Finance): If they opt into the soft-cap + 12mo commit, I can model a small one-time credit to keep effective price flat this year. I'll include that in the renewal appendix.
Peyton (Solutions Eng): Rolling the batching changes into staging now. Will report sample token reductions after a 30m run.
SpendAlertBot: info: ticket CS-11111 created to track AuroraAI backfill optimization and QBR artifacts.
Lena (CS): Thanks all 44d — will post graphs and the runbook summary here after tomorrow's call.
